programmes.t: Rifftrax Live: House On Haunted Hill
programmes.d: Yes, horror classic House on Haunted Hill provides a mesmerizing walk down “people actually used to find this SCARY?!” lane. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with live commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

programmes.t: RiffTrax: Day of the Shorts SF Sketchfest 2019
programmes.d: Live from SF Sketchfest, it's Day of the Shorts: Sketchfest 2019! This feature is a parody and contains the original shorts combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K) and other comedy guests.

programmes.t: RiffTrax: The Boy in the Plastic Bubble
programmes.d: John Travolta plays Todd Lubitch, a boy who was born without any immunities and cannot venture outside his sterile environment, lest he slip on a banana peel and end up on America's Funniest Home Videos.

programmes.t: RiffTrax: Little Shop of Horrors: Three Riffer Edition
programmes.d: Fans of shops of horrors will love this nostalgic look back, before the days of the massive chain stores, and big box horror shops.

RiffTrax bring their comedic riffing treatment to this "so bad it's still bad" movie where ancient indian gods come back from the dead to torment pretty co-eds and get whipped by Lash LaRue! Commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill (former stars of MST3K.)
The youth of today, no longer content to roll a hoop with a stick, play endless hours of mumbly peg, or work a lathe at a factory 14 hours a day for just pennies, need something to occupy them.

programmes.t: Rifftrax Shorts: David and Hazel: A Story in Communication
programmes.d: Let Mike, Kevin, and Bill invite David and Hazel into your home. This feature parodies the original movie by combining it with comedic commentary from Mike, Kevin, and Bill of RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

programmes.t: RiffTrax Short: It Must Be The Neighbors
programmes.d: Bill Duncan had it all until the day when he discovered that his garbage cans had been deemed unfit for use by the city sanitation committee.

There have been many, many Plan 9s all throughout history, some of them more successful than others, all of them terrestrial - it took a man with the vision of Ed Wood to show us the very real horrors of a Plan 9 from Outer Space!

MST3K stars Bridget Nelson and Mary Jo Pehl, under the RiffTrax Presents banner, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 1950's space adventure classic! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary
McBain is the movie that will have you saying, Seriously, Christopher Walken did this only three years before Pulp Fiction? Join Mike, Kevin, Bill and Rainier Wolfcastle for McBain, Let's Get Silly.
